title: Generic Structural Stability for Riemann Solutions to $n \times n$ Systems of Hyperbolic Conservation Laws
summary: This paper proves generic structural stability for Riemann solutions to $n \times n$ systems of hyperbolic conservation laws in one spatial dimension. Under assumptions of strict hyperbolicity, genuine nonlinearity, and a regular manifold hypothesis on the Rankine-Hugoniot map, we show that for almost every pair of left and right states, any $n$-wave Riemann solution consisting of Lax-admissible shocks and rarefactions is structurally stable under perturbations of the left state, the right state, and the flux function in the $C^2$ topology.
